mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_reconcile_diff (business_date, order_no, diff_type, detail, dedupe_key, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, resolved_at) VALUES (#{businessDate}, #{orderNo}, #{diffType}, #{detail}, #{dedupeKey}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{resolvedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dedupe_key = dedupe_key
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_reconcile_diff WHERE diff_type = 'EXEC_GAP' AND status = 'OPEN' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_reconcile_diff SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_reconcile_diff SET next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_reconcile_diff SET attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, status = 'OPEN', next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{backoffSeconds} SECOND) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_reconcile_diff WHERE diff_type = 'EXEC_GAP' AND status = 'OPEN'
